SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk 
FROM (
    SELECT 
        i_category, 
        i_class, 
        i_brand, 
        i_product_name, 
        d_year, 
        d_qoy, 
        d_moy, 
        s_store_id, 
        sumsales, 
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk 
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            i.i_category, 
            i.i_class, 
            i.i_brand, 
            i.i_product_name, 
            d.d_year, 
            d.d_qoy, 
            d.d_moy, 
            s.s_store_id, 
            SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales 
        FROM store_sales ss
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1228
        GROUP BY 
            i.i_category, 
            i.i_class, 
            i.i_brand, 
            i.i_product_name, 
            d.d_year, 
            d.d_qoy, 
            d.d_moy, 
            s.s_store_id
    ) AS dw1 
    WHERE rk <= 100 
    ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk 
    LIMIT 100
) AS dw2
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
